programme.title: Ski jumping: World Cup competition in Wisła
programme.desc: The Adam Małysz ski jumping hill in Wisła is the third stop of this year's World Cup. After unpleasant views at the beginning of the season in Lillehammer, where only a handful of (mainly Polish) fans appeared in the stands, here we can count on the fans' loud support. The main actors should be the Austrians, who performed fantastically at the inauguration. Both the old guard and the young wolves showed phenomenal form. Last year's Crystal Ball winner, Stefan Kraft, was just off the podium twice in Lillehammer. The lowest step on the first day was taken by Maximilian Ortner... who was called up for this competition on an emergency basis and it was only his third appearance in the World Cup competition. If we add the excellent performances of Jan Hoerl and Daniel Tschofenig, we have clear favorites in the Nations Cup competition

Moreover, for the first time this season there will be a team sprint, in which the Polish national team is strong

programme.title: ⋗ Women's volleyball: Club World Championship. A.Carraro Prosecco Doc Imoco Conegliano – Orlando Valkyries
programme.desc: At the beginning of the tournament in Sao Paulo, the team from Conegliano, defending the title of club world champions, will face the team of Major League Volleyball champions, who are participating in the tournament thanks to a wild card granted by the FIVB. Joanna Wołosz and her friends should have no problems defeating Orlando Valkyries

programme.title: ⋗ Women's volleyball: Tauron Liga. UNI Opole – #VolleyWrocław
programme.desc: The revelation of this season versus the weakest team in the league, apart from the newcomer from Nowy Dwór Mazowiecki, which won only one of eight matches in the current campaign. Wolczyce from Opole defeated in three sets, among others: Budowlani Łódź and BKS Bielsko-Biała, i.e. teams much stronger than the #VolleyWrocław team. If Bartłomiej Dąbrowski's players approach this match with appropriate concentration, they should add their seventh victory in the ongoing TAURON Liga campaign

programme.title: Football: German league. Borussia Dortmund – TSG 1899 Hoffenheim
programme.desc: Borussia Dortmund, third in the Bundesliga table, and TSG Hoffenheim, fifth, are only two points apart. BVB, aspiring to the championship, must do everything in its power to show the visitors a place in the row. If Niko Kovač's players lose points at Signal Iduna Park, catching Bayern Munich will seem like an impossible mission.

programme.title: Football: Italian League. SSC Napoli – Juventus FC
programme.desc: The Bianconeri have not beaten Napoli away since 2019. This season, however, they have already exceeded the limit of mistakes and must try to break the bad series. Juventus' defeat against Lazio in October resulted in the dismissal of coach Igor Tudor. He was replaced by Luciano Spalletti, who started his term with a triumph over Cremonese and draws with Torino and Fiorentina. The meeting with the Italian champion will be his most difficult test so far, also for sentimental reasons. Spaletti worked in the Vesuvius team in 2021-2023, winning the Coppa Italia with them.

programme.title: Combat sports: Babilon Boxing Show & K-1 in Legionowo. Jan Lodzik – Mateusz Polski 20/10/2023
programme.desc: The fans will witness the fight for the WBC Francophone belt in the welterweight category. Jan Lodzik and Mateusz Polski, undefeated in their professional careers, will face each other. The first of them defeated Konrad Dąbrowski in his previous fight. The boxer from Białogard has already fought two winning fights this year - against Denis Madry and Konstantine Jangavadze

programme.title: Dutch league magazine

programme.title: Men's volleyball: PlusLiga. JSW Jastrzębski Węgiel – Asseco Resovia Rzeszów

programme.title: Formula 1: Abu Dhabi Grand Prix
programme.desc: When it seemed that the question of who would become the new world champion would be an internal matter for McLaren drivers, the finish of this year's series unexpectedly took a turn. A structural failure of the British team led to the disqualification of Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri in the Las Vegas GP. Thanks to this, Max Verstappen gained a real chance to overtake his main rivals in the title race in the final straight. In the season-ending competition in the UAE, we will see whether the Dutchman's pursuit will be a spectacular success.

programme.desc: It's time to crown a new champion of the tournament in Madrid. It remains to be seen who will join the group of winners of this event, which includes Iga Świątek and Aryna Sabalenka. The winner of the competition will be richer by EUR 985,000 and her account in the WTA ranking will be credited with 1,000 points.

programme.desc: It's time to crown a new champion of the tournament in Rome. It remains to be seen who will join the group of winners of this event, which includes Iga Świątek and Jelena Rybakina. The winner of the competition will be richer by EUR 877,000 and her account in the WTA ranking will be credited with 1,000 points.

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Strasbourg - singles final match: Lyudmila Samsonova - Elena Rybakina
programme.desc: It's time to crown a new champion of the tournament in Strasbourg. It remains to be seen who will join the group of winners of this event, which includes Madison Keys and Elina Svitolina. The winner of the competition will be richer by EUR 123,000 and her account in the WTA ranking will be credited with 500 points.

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Berlin – singles final match: Markéta Vondroušová – Wang Xinyu
programme.desc: Both women eliminated their higher-ranked rivals in the semi-finals. Wang Xinyu defeated Lyudmila Samsonova, who was ranked 19th (6:4, 6:1), and Markéta Vondroušová defeated Aryna Sabalenka, who was the leader of the WTA rankings (6:2, 6:4). After these victories, the Chinese and Czech have no intention of resting on their laurels and want to leave Berlin with the trophy.

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in London - singles final match: Amanda Anisimova - Tatjana Maria
programme.desc: Tatjana Maria in London may become one of the oldest WTA tournament winners in history. Thus, the German woman can join the group that includes, among others: Serena Willimans. The tennis player, at the age of 38, won the competition in Auckland in 2020. However, she must first defeat Amanda Anisimova. The American in Great Britain wants to win her second trophy this season. She won her first in Doha after defeating Jelena Ostapenko (6:4, 6:3)

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Bogota - singles final match: Katarzyna Kawa - Camila Osorio
programme.desc: Katarzyna Kawa impresses with her form during this year's edition of the competition in Bogota. On her way to the final, the Pole met, among others: top-seeded Marie Bouzkova (5:7, 6:1, 7:5). In her last match in Colombia, she will face Camila Osorio. The clash with the Colombian is a chance for Kawa to win her first WTA 250 tournament

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Bad Homburg – singles final match: Jessica Pegula – Iga Świątek
programme.desc: The last time Iga Świątek played in the title-deciding match was in 2024 during the French Open. The Pole then defeated Jasmine Paolini, with whom she this time competed for the final of the tournament in Bad Homburg. The Raszynian also now easily beat the Italian (6:1, 6:3). Additionally, this victory allowed her to jump to 4th place in the WTA ranking at the expense of Paolini. However, the Polish tennis player has no intention of stopping and wants to end her competition in Germany with the trophy

He was replaced by Luciano Spalletti, who started his term with a triumph over Cremonese and draws with Torino and Fiorentina. The meeting with the Italian champion will be his most difficult test so far, also for sentimental reasons. Spaletti worked in the Vesuvius team in 2021-2023, winning the Coppa Italia with them.

programme.title: Giants that are no more – The story of the Tasmanian direwolf | S01E06
programme.desc: The program reveals the secrets of the largest beasts that have ever lived on our planet. Viewers will look at deadly tyrannosaurs, saber-toothed tigers and sea monsters. The results of the latest research will reveal, among other things, how these giant animals evolved, why they were so large and what caused their extinction... Great Britain. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Primates – The most important thing is family | E02
programme.desc: A documentary series devoted to our favorite primates, presenting species that are rarely shown on screen. Modern technology has enabled creators to capture their world from a unique perspective and in their natural environment, whether it is the treetops of a flood forest or the dense bushes shrouded in the darkness of a Sri Lankan night. Over the course of two years, the filmmakers undertook twenty-eight expeditions around the world, braving snowstorms in the Moroccan Atlas Mountains and wading through flooded jungles in remote corners of Sumatra and Brazil. They were among the first in history to immortalize the newly discovered Tapanuli orangutan species and were the first in years to attempt to film a white uakari. One team spent over two months in Equatorial Guinea, camping on a remote beach to record the most intimate scenes from the life of a mandrill, one of the least understood primates in the world. In Sri Lanka, thanks to low-light technology, the first color images of mysterious gray loris in the wild were captured at night. Captivating animal stories combine real family drama with cutting-edge science. A seemingly terrifying silver-backed mountain gorilla encountered on the volcanic slopes of the Congo turns out to be a gentle and caring father to its young. According to the latest research, it is caring fathers who achieve the greatest reproductive success. Viewers will also see South Africa's elusive pygmy galago, part of a recently discovered urban population, as it raids the local zoo at night. In Malaysia, they will learn about the world of treetops from the perspective of white-handed gibbons, shown on screen for the first time in history. The unique series is narrated by naturalist Chris Packham. In the forests of Southeast Asia you can meet some of the most agile animals. White-handed gibbons must cover long distances quickly. They do it in a unique way. In the Amazon basin, white-faced spider monkeys have adapted well to living in treetops. USA, Great Britain. 2020. documentary film

programme.title: China: the ancient kingdom of nature - the West: a delicate paradise | E01
programme.desc: A journey through China's extraordinary national parks. Foxes, antelopes and snow leopards live in difficult conditions in the mighty mountains. In the dense forests you can meet agile snub-nosed monkeys and pandas. Wild animals also settle on the outskirts of cities. People must make room for nature and exist in harmony with fauna. Protected areas constitute twenty percent of the entire country. People in China must adapt to the rules in force in order to protect valuable nature. A journey through the national parks of the Middle Kingdom. Foxes, antelopes and snow leopards live in difficult conditions in the mighty mountains. In the dense forests you can meet agile monkeys and pandas. Wild animals also settle on the outskirts of large cities. Great Britain. 2020. documentary film

During this dangerous expedition, the explorer will visit one of the world's last cannibal tribes, try to catch a huge saltwater crocodile and admire the astonishingly beautiful birds of paradise. programme.desc: A nature series devoted to the world's first artificial waterhole and the animals that use it. It was created in a reserve in Tanzania, an area of ​​the African savannah with poor water resources. It is not only an excellent vantage point for hidden cameras, but also a place of respite for wild animals such as lions, baboons, elephants, giraffes and buffalos. Thanks to hidden cameras, scientists want to track the secret behaviors of creatures gathering around the waterhole. They are wondering, among other things: whether half-year changes affect their customs and how predators and their prey coexist on a daily basis. For creatures such as lions, baboons, elephants, giraffes and buffalos, the waterhole is a place of respite. It is a field of observation for scientists. programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.desc: Yellowstone in winter is a place of ice and bubbling springs. While grizzlies and beavers retreat, wolves, foxes and otters bravely fight for survival in the icy wilderness. (Station info).

programme.title: Yellowstone
programme.desc: In summer, Yellowstone is wild and unpredictable. Predators hunt, parents fight for their young, bears face off against wolves and even hummingbirds defend their territory in the air. (Station info).

programme.title: Wild Caribbean with Liz Bonnin
programme.desc: In the Dominican Republic, presenter Liz Bonnin climbs an 18 meter high palm tree and saves a buzzard chick. She then helps free trapped flamingos. (Station info).

programme.title: Wild Caribbean with Liz Bonnin
programme.desc: In Belize, presenter Liz Bonnin tracks a jaguar that is suspected of killing the locals' pigs. She then helps tag manatees in the Antilles. (Station info).

programme.title: Animal Park: Zoo Stories from Longleat
programme.desc: The unborn young of a doe is in the wrong position. The zookeepers leave no stone unturned to save mother and calf. And what about the offspring in the wolf enclosure? (Station info).

programme.title: Animal Park: Zoo Stories from Longleat
programme.desc: The young Siberian tigers Red and Yana are getting closer. Can the animal keepers look forward to having offspring soon? Meanwhile, hyrax Tadallah is in mortal danger. (Station info).

programme.title: Sommer in Alaska
programme.desc: Alaska's summer attracts animals from near and far with its huge food supply: local bears and seals are just as happy about the feast as well-traveled whales. (Station info).

programme.title: Tayrona – Colombia’s natural paradise
programme.desc: For the animals of Tayrona National Park, every day is an adventure and a fight for survival: Will there be enough food and protection from predators? (Station info).

programme.title: The Peninsula – The Wild Stories of Iberia
programme.desc: The Mediterranean forest provides a habitat for countless species. Cork and holm oaks characterize the picturesque landscape. An iconic big cat is at home here: the Iberian lynx. (Station info).

programme.title: The Peninsula – The Wild Stories of Iberia
programme.desc: Mountains, rivers and forests create a very unique ecosystem on the Iberian Peninsula. The wild inhabitants who have found their home in the mountains also contribute to this. (Station info).

programme.title: Wild North Atlantic
programme.desc: Ken O'Sullivan begins his journey in the dark waters off the coast of Northern Ireland. From there, the underwater filmmaker delves into the hidden secrets of the North Atlantic. (Station info).

programme.title: Big blue wilderness
programme.desc: The Bahamas is surrounded by thriving coral reefs, underground caves and steep barrier reefs. All kinds of creatures cavort in the turquoise waters off the white sandy beaches: agile reef sharks, large whitetip sharks, manatees, sea turtles and wild dolphins. (Station info).

programme.title: Big blue wilderness
programme.desc: Over 200 caves are home to an incredible variety of marine life and corals in this underwater kingdom 40 km from Belize. This deep blue wilderness is inhabited by rare, exotic fish, Myliobatidae, sharks and giant green moray eels. (Station info).

programme.desc: Tập 2 Thi thể của Forrest đã được tìm thấy ở sông Seine. Bowman được giao nhiệm vụ thuyết phục gia đình rằng anh ta đã tự sát, nhưng Chloé, con gái của người quá cố, bác bỏ lời cáo buộc và quyết định tự mình điều tra cái chết của anh ta. Trong khi đó Villeneuve muốn đưa Saskia ra tòa, bất chấp lời khuyên của những người xung quanh. programme.title: THE CURSE OF OAK ISLAND S11 EP21
programme.desc: Nhóm cuối cùng đã đạt được độ sâu mục tiêu ở Garden Shaft, nhưng nỗ lực khoan của họ có thể bị cản trở bởi đường hầm lũ huyền thoại.

programme.title: HISTORY'S GREATEST MYSTERIES S4 EP02
programme.desc: Vào ngày 22 tháng 11 năm 1963, Tổng thống John F Kennedy bị ám sát, làm chấn động cả đất nước. Trong khi nghi phạm ban đầu đã bị bắt, nhiều người tin rằng câu chuyện còn nhiều điều khác nữa.

programme.title: HISTORY'S GREATEST ESCAPES WITH MORGAN FREEMAN S2 EP12
programme.desc: Một phi công người Mỹ gốc Đức, Dieter Dengler, sử dụng các kỹ năng sinh tồn được mài giũa khi còn nhỏ để trốn thoát khỏi nhà tù bí mật ở Lào trong những năm đầu của chiến tranh Việt Nam.

programme.title: THE UNXPLAINED WITH WILLIAM SHATNER S3 EP37
programme.desc: Trên khắp thế giới, đã có rất nhiều trường hợp nhìn thấy những sinh vật kỳ quái mà khoa học không thể giải thích được. Phải chăng có những con quái vật đáng sợ đang ẩn nấp trong bóng tối của hành tinh Trái đất?

programme.title: THE BERMUDA TRIANGLE: INTO CURSED WATERS S2 EP06
programme.desc: Nhóm tiến tới mục tiêu mà họ tin là Nữ hoàng lưu huỳnh biển đã thất lạc từ lâu. Chiếc tàu chở dầu khổng lồ này đã biến mất vào năm 1963 cùng với thủy thủ đoàn 39 người và là một trong những xác tàu mất tích mang tính biểu tượng nhất của Tam giác quỷ Bermuda.
